blocking_conditions.detail: The stability domain contains instances with three or four depots, but the instruction only says reassign to another depot and does not freeze which destination is used.

method_changes_not_taken: No D2-A fleet cap was enlarged or pooled across depots.
No stability instance or 50 percent cell was removed.
No unserved-customer relaxation or penalty was introduced.
No outcome-conditioned reassignment map was selected.
required_user_decision: Approve a destination and hard-feasibility conditioning rule for three/four-depot stability mappings.
Or approve a D2/partial-service model change for structurally infeasible 50 percent stability cells.
Or authorize running the feasible main exhibit while recording the requested stability panel as HALT.
